            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))

                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx

            ys = [y for y, x in cells]

            comps.append((color, cells, min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)))

    # A long, narrow connected component is a color marker. It recolors
    # the closest other component, leaving the marker itself unchanged.

            markers.append((i, color, cells))

    claimed = set()
